terms.definition: A closed shape with four straight sides and four vertices.
terms.whyItMatters: Quadrilaterals are the shapes of rooms, doors, and screens.

terms.definition: The total of the four interior angles — always 360°.
terms.function: Comes from two triangles of 180° each.
terms.whereItIs: The total tag above the plate.
terms.whyItMatters: The angle sum lets you find missing angles instantly.

terms.function: Each has special side and angle rules.
terms.whyItMatters: Knowing the family lets you classify any four-sided shape.

terms.definition: Quadrilaterals flex when pushed; a diagonal brace locks them.
terms.function: The diagonal creates two rigid triangles.
terms.whyItMatters: This is why gates and frames get diagonal braces.
